text:
diego_seo: Quick thread 1 launch checklist: keywords -> pages, minimal JSON-LD for webinar, internal anchors, and a simple redirect plan for any promo retirements.

julia_growth: Love it. Goals: launch post that points to benchmark pillar, webinar landing with gated PDF, and HubSpot routing to SDR.

sara_writer: Seed keywords ready: 
- llm-inference-costs
- low-latency-llm
- production-llm-serving
I'll map them to URLs in the sheet.

mike_prod: Form needs hidden fields for utm_source / utm_campaign / page_slug. Routing rule: utm_campaign=webinar_bench -> SDR_BENCH.

eng_infra: For redirects we'll preserve querystrings. Example nginx snippet: `return 301 https://redwood.example.com/benchmarks/llm-inference-2026$request_uri;`

diego_seo: Canonical strategy: pillar `/benchmarks/llm-inference-2026` canonical to itself; launch posts and webinar landing self-canonical. Retired promos -> 301 to pillar.

julia_growth: Webinar landing should be short and indexable; link to pillar for full data. No noindex.

diego_seo: Schema: add Event JSON-LD on landing + BreadcrumbList + small Dataset snippet for the benchmark table. Keep JSON-LD lightweight.

seo-bot: scheduled crawl /benchmarks/llm-inference-2026; frequency: daily; window: 7d; alert: #marketing if >50 404s.

sara_writer: I'll post the keyword->URL sheet and sample meta titles before tomorrow's review.

mike_prod: We'll implement form fields and HubSpot mapping by Tue. Eng will push redirect rules to staging Wed.

diego_seo: Pre-launch quick checklist: meta title <=70 chars, meta desc ~150 chars, OG image, structured data validated, >=2 internal links, canonical, sitemap updated. Review call tomorrow 09:30 PT.

julia_growth: See you all then :rocket:
